🏢 MI HB 6264 — Data Centers Face New Energy Rules in Michigan

Michigan is setting new standards for data centers, requiring all facilities to use 100% clean or renewable energy by 2040. This means data center owners and operators must secure energy through methods like on-site generation, power purchase agreements, or approved contracts, with the Michigan Public Service Commission overseeing these efforts. Failure to comply could result in civil fines of up to $10,000 per day. ...
